review_views.label: Full composition
review_views.evidence: The exact 1536x1024 RGB candidate was inspected against the composition guide and the full native contact.
review_views.notes: K1 is the strongest complete flat-board candidate so far. Sea, five delta islands, forest, river, capital, port, roads, highland, fields, and connecting ground are all present without perspective or a frame.

review_views.label: 25 percent review
review_views.notes: The primary geography remains recognizable, but the strict 25 percent macrocell coverage threshold fails and some quiet land structure collapses.

review_views.label: 50 percent review
review_views.notes: The region hierarchy, river, coast, settlements, and roads remain clear. The 50 percent readability proxy passes.

review_views.label: Native review
review_views.notes: The palette and dry copperplate print finish are coherent. At native scale, dense field rows, repeated upper-right hatch clusters, and the capital's exact radial cadence are already visible as mechanical material systems.

review_views.label: 200 percent review
review_views.notes: Sea marks remain sparse and disconnected and forest reads as mottled areal cover. Highland resolves into many similarly sized multi-stroke dash clusters, fields resolve into dense parallel row wallpaper, and capital blocks repeat concentrically.

review_views.label: 400 percent review
review_views.notes: Deep zoom confirms reusable highland hatch bundles, mechanically parallel agricultural rows, and highly regular radial urban blocks. These are semantic-repetition failures even though exact-block repetition proxies pass.

review_views.label: Nine-region review
review_views.notes: Every third of the board is populated and continuous with no pasted patch or quadrant boundary. The defects are repeated regional grammars rather than missing coverage.

review_views.label: Water, delta, and river
review_views.evidence: Western and delta panels were inspected at native, 200 percent, 400 percent, and in the nine-region contact.
review_views.notes: The calm slate-blue sea, sparse disconnected marks, braided delta, and river continuity are successful. No cellular lattice, dominant wave band, or broken junction was found.

review_views.label: Forest material
review_views.evidence: Northern forest panels were inspected at native, 200 percent, and 400 percent.
review_views.notes: K1 substantially improves on J1: the forest is continuous mottled stipple and broken micro-texture without obvious closed crown loops or icon rows. It remains dense but is not an immediate rejection by itself.

review_views.label: Highland material
review_views.evidence: Upper-right panels were inspected at native, 200 percent, 400 percent, and in the nine-region contact.
review_views.notes: The projection is flat, but the surface repeatedly uses similarly sized three-to-five-stroke bundles and curved dash chains instead of broad tonal zones with sparse independent hachure.

review_views.label: Fields and capital
review_views.evidence: Central and lower-right panels were inspected at native, 200 percent, 400 percent, and in the nine-region contact.
review_views.notes: All field parcels and the circular capital are legible, but uniform parallel crop rows fill the parcels and the capital repeats concentric rings, radial lanes, and near-identical blocks with machine-like cadence.

review_views.label: Guide geometry alignment
review_views.evidence: world/map-production/qa/automated/style-candidate-k-v1-full-board.json reports stable land-sea agreement 0.996150, candidate-to-guide within-8px coverage 0.764898, guide-to-candidate coverage 0.814361, and p95 distances 15.7876 and 13.1814 px.
review_views.notes: Macro topology is preserved, but the strict bidirectional 95 percent within 8 px geometry contract fails.

immediate_failures.label: Text or pseudo-writing
immediate_failures.evidence: No labels, readable strings, pseudo-writing rows, signature, watermark, title, legend, or cartouche were found.

immediate_failures.label: Perspective, side faces, or directional lighting
immediate_failures.evidence: Coast, river, settlements, forest, highland, and fields remain in a strict vertical plan view without raised landforms, cliffs, walls, roofs, or cast shadows.

immediate_failures.label: Missing required composition
immediate_failures.evidence: All required regions, five delta islands, settlements, roads, waterways, fields, and quiet corridors are present.

immediate_failures.label: Broken road or river network
immediate_failures.evidence: River, delta branches, roads, capital links, port links, and coastline connections remain continuous in every reviewed view.

immediate_failures.label: Forest loop or icon wallpaper
immediate_failures.evidence: At 200 and 400 percent the forest is dense mottled areal texture, but no dominant closed crown-loop, tree-icon, rosette, or glyph-row vocabulary was identified.

immediate_failures.label: Repeated highland hatch bundles
immediate_failures.evidence: At 200 and 400 percent the upper-right region repeatedly uses similarly sized three-to-five-stroke bundles and chained curved dash families across broad areas.

immediate_failures.label: Rigid field-row and parcel repetition
immediate_failures.evidence: At native, 200, and 400 percent the agricultural parcels are filled by dense mechanically parallel rows with little local interruption or spacing variation.

immediate_failures.label: Mechanical capital radial repetition
immediate_failures.evidence: At native, 200, and 400 percent the capital repeats concentric rings, uniformly spaced spokes, and near-identical block footprints with an overly mechanical cadence.

immediate_failures.label: Visible edge seam or pasted patch
immediate_failures.evidence: The boundary proxy passes and all reviewed edges show one continuous borderless plate without frame, patch edge, quadrant seam, or pasted band.

scores.label: Composition and strict plan geometry
scores.notes: Complete flat composition and intact macro topology, reduced by the failed bidirectional 95 percent within 8 px alignment contract.

scores.label: Palette and parent-style continuity
scores.notes: B1 character is visually close and mean-channel delta passes, but RGB intersection 0.690745, HSV intersection 0.618622, and Bhattacharyya 0.888634 miss their strict minima.

scores.label: Edge and seam continuity
scores.notes: The board is full-bleed and coherent with no visible boundary seam, frame, quadrant, or pasted region.

scores.label: Material and line-style consistency
scores.notes: Water and forest are strong, but highland bundles, field rows, and mechanical urban cadence weaken the intended nonperiodic material language.

scores.label: Multiscale detail and readability
scores.notes: Native and 50 percent hierarchy are clear, while the strict 25 percent macrocell coverage gate fails at 0.802083.

scores.label: Semantic nonrepetition
scores.notes: Highland, fields, and capital trigger immediate semantic-repetition failures despite passing exact and generic repetition proxies.

scores.label: Network and overlay readability
scores.notes: Roads, waterways, coast, settlements, piers, and major region boundaries remain exceptionally clear at all reviewed scales.

summary: K1 is the strongest full-board result so far and materially improves sea, forest, flat projection, palette coherence, and network readability. It is still rejected as Golden at 87/100. Automated B1 palette, 25 percent readability, and 8 px geometry-alignment gates fail. Vision inspection at 200 and 400 percent also finds immediate semantic-repetition failures in highland hatch bundles, agricultural row wallpaper, and the capital's concentric radial block cadence. The candidate remains review-only and must not enter the manifest, renderer, or release.
required_changes: Preserve K1's flat complete composition, calm water, mottled forest, palette direction, port, delta, and network clarity.
Replace upper-right repeated hatch bundles with broad planar tonal zones and sparse independently ending short marks without recurring multi-stroke motifs.
Replace dense parallel crop rows with broken, locally drifting, irregularly interrupted agricultural marks and less mechanical parcel cadence.
Break the capital's repeated concentric block vocabulary while preserving the circular footprint and all road connections.
Meet all B1 palette thresholds and raise 25 percent macrocell contrast coverage without darkening the sea.
Keep 95 percent of the bidirectional guide geometry within 8 px while retaining the hand-printed edge character.
